text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I arrived at a sporting goods store's 
bargain clearance sale.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A huge crowd of horse girls lined up in 
front of the shop, eagerly waiting for the 
sale to begin at any moment.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's almost time~. No matter who our 
rivals are, we're not gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for inviting me, Ines! All 
right...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Those cu—I mean, high-performance shoes 
I've had my eye on forever, I'm definitely 
getting them!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Bargain sales are battlefield 
battlegrounds, right? I'll do my very best 
to win♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the bargain sale began, with each 
carrying their own hidden motives――

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Heeeyah!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: This one next!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Packed with swarms of shoppers, the store 
had turned into a battlefield—and Ines 
Fujin was blazing through it like a storm.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... That's way tougher than I 
thought. Time for a tactical retreat!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that was so much fun! All that 
hustling and jostling felt just like a 
race, didn't it?♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wait, really...?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Good work, everyone! Did you manage to get 
what you were after~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Nah. The competition for mine was crazy 
fierce.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Though Fine-chan, I don't know if you had 
a specific target or what... It looked 
like you were just grabbing at anything 
within arm's reach.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My target was simply enjoying the bargain 
sale, you see♪ And I savored every single 
moment of it!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You're truly amazing, Ines-san. Are all 
those bags on the bench your spoils?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'm just used to it, that's all! 
You see――

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Frozen foods, fifty percent off?! I've 
gotta go for it!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
If I stock up big right now, we won't have 
to worry about side dishes for a while!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Fiiiight~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. "Twinkle☆Wand", huh... So that's what 
you want.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, your big sis will buy it for 
you! I've got some wiggle room in my 
wallet this month♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(There'll be tons of rivals because of the 
Christmas sale, but I definitely won't 
lose!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And that's how I've spent all these years 
tackling bargain sales for my home and my 
little sisters!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Ines, even nowadays you still bolt 
out of the room going, "It's bargain 
time!" every now and then.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Is that so?♪ Perhaps your remarkable 
strength in races was nurtured through 
your everyday life!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~, maybe, just maybe!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right! What you wanted, 
Ryan-chan... It was that cute pair of 
shoes, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wh-Whaaat?! How did you know...?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Big sis sees right through everything~♪ So 
leave it to me, I'll go grab them for you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Ines-san, wait for me~! I want to do 
some more bargain shopping too♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Haha. There's just no matching a "big 
sis", is there?
